description: Client errors the proxy writes outside the typed error layer (internal/lokierr through p.fail), counted from internal/proxy's production code by TestErrorLayerSites: free_text_sites (calls of a writer that takes the client text as a string, or http.Error), error_text_sites (those whose text holds an error's own text), raw_error_status_writes (WriteHeader with a constant status of 400 or more outside the error shape functions), parser_message_calls (calls of lokierr.ParserMessage, the bridge for the LogQL parser's own rendered message, which must never carry another error's text), and known_leak_pairs (the ceiling of error-layer-known-leaks.json: its route x failure-mode cell and registry case pairs). They may only fall: a category that grows fails, and one that falls fails until this file holds the new counts (LVP_ERROR_LAYER_SITES_UPDATE=1 rewrites it). Each goes to 0 as client errors move to the typed layer.
